harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (node1/node2/node3, Ubuntu 16.04 i386, package from apt since no pre-existing cluster was found) and wrote application keys. Simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory so recovery from local data was impossible), then performed the standard etcd replacement procedure: removed the dead member (9e27ac9b72d2dc69) via `etcdctl member remove` while node1/node2 quorum stayed healthy, added a new member (a42e73c624ed3d37) via `etcdctl member add`, and started etcd on node3 with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing and a fresh data dir. The new member synced and all pre-existing application keys were verified present on node3. Enabled etcd on all nodes for boot persistence. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot IDs and etcd health for all three nodes, then rebooted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (never concurrently), confirming a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on each after restart, and confirming `etcdctl cluster-health`/`member list` showed 3/3 healthy members with all application keys (including a post-replacement marker key) intact after each individual restart before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3: no existing etcd cluster or install (Ubuntu 16.04 i686, no etcd/etcdctl binary)
Installed etcd 2.2.5 (apt package, i386) on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/default/etcd on each node with unique ETCD_NAME, peer/client URLs bound to $NODE_IP, and ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER listing all three members, ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=new
Started etcd on all three nodes to bootstrap a 3-member cluster; verified 'cluster is healthy' and member list shows node1/node2/node3
Wrote application keys under /app/config, /app/feature-flags, /app/secrets and verified replication to node3
Captured baseline boot_id for node1, node2, node3 before disruption
Simulated permanent loss of node3's etcd member: stopped etcd and deleted /var/lib/etcd/default on node3
Verified node1/node2 quorum remained healthy with node3 reported unreachable, and application data still readable
Removed the dead member (9e27ac9b72d2dc69) via etcdctl member remove on node1
Added a new member (node3, a42e73c624ed3d37) via etcdctl member add on node1
Reconfigured node3's /etc/default/etcd with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing and updated ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER, fresh data dir, and started etcd
Verified cluster returned to 3/3 healthy members and all pre-existing application keys were present on the new node3 member
Wrote and verified a post-replacement marker key replicated to all members
Enabled etcd service (systemctl enable) on all three nodes for boot persistence
Rebooted node1, waited for reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed etcd active and cluster-health 3/3 with data intact before proceeding
Rebooted node2, waited for reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed etcd active and cluster-health 3/3 with data intact before proceeding
Rebooted node3 (the replaced member), waited for reconnect, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, member list correct, and all application keys plus marker key intact

evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member etcd cluster running and healthy on node1/node2/node3 with application keys
evidence.summary: member list/cluster-health show 3 healthy members (node1/node2/node3); application keys written and confirmed readable from node3

evidence.requirement: Pre-disruption boot identity baseline for all nodes
evidence.summary: boot_id captured for node1 (dca72801...), node2 (74fd91b6...), node3 (d08fb446...) before any restart

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (unrecoverable data loss) while quorum and data preserved
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped and /var/lib/etcd/default deleted; node1 shows node3 unreachable while node1/node2 remain healthy and db_host key still readable

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed and new member added/joined replacing node3
evidence.summary: etcdctl member remove of dead ID, member add of new node3 ID, node3 reconfigured with existing-cluster state and started, cluster returns to 3/3 healthy members with new node3 ID

evidence.requirement: Existing application keys intact on replaced member and cluster-wide after replacement
evidence.summary: all original keys (db_host, db_port, new-ui flag, api-key-ref) readable from new node3 member; a post-replacement marker key written and confirmed replicated to all three members

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/cluster state
evidence.summary: reboot command returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from dca72801... to 26958f49...; post-reboot etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/cluster state
evidence.summary: reboot command returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from 74fd91b6... to 9c9e70eb...; post-reboot etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, keys intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered service/cluster/membership state for the replaced member
evidence.summary: reboot command returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from d08fb446... to 7ba0892f...; post-reboot etcd active, cluster-health 3/3, member list shows correct replaced-member ID, all application keys and marker key intact
